name: Color Picker / Swatch
summary: Fieldset-and-legend color choice group whose named native radios own selection, form value, constraint validation, and reset while visual swatches retain visible names and a non-color selected boundary.

anatomy.description: Visible group question and accessible fieldset name.

anatomy.name: requiredIndicator
anatomy.description: Decorative asterisk optically centered with the group legend when one color choice is required.

anatomy.name: options
anatomy.description: Wrapping layout container for the native radio options.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.description: Native radio input for the color option.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.description: Visible color name and accessible label text for the wrapping native radio.

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer hover state on a swatch.

states.name: disabled

behavior.name: nativeChoice
behavior.description: Named native radios own mutually exclusive selection, submitted value, keyboard operation, reset, and required-group validation.

behavior.name: selectionState
behavior.description: Visual selection follows the native checked state; the double boundary remains perceivable without relying on the authored fill color or optional check.

behavior.name: colorName
behavior.description: Each swatch has a visible name supplied by the wrapping label; color alone is never the option name.

behavior.name: selectionOwnership
attributes: checked establishes initial checkedness in static HTML
one controlled group value in framework adapters
behavior.description: Static Web delegates live selection to the native group. Controlled adapters bind one group value instead of independent booleans that can yield multiple selections.

properties.description: Visible question naming the complete color group.

properties.description: Validation presentation for the color choice group.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Visible accessible color name for an individual swatch.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Native radio group name shared by swatches.

properties.description: Value submitted for this color when its native radio is selected.

properties.description: Id reference for helper or validation feedback associated with the fieldset.

accessibility: Wrap the named native radio group in a fieldset with one visible legend.
Provide a visible accessible color name for every swatch.
Keep each option activation target at least 44 by 44 CSS pixels even when its visible fill is smaller.
Do not communicate selection only through the authored fill color or optional check; preserve the independent selected boundary.
Use aria-invalid only for Error and associate helper or validation feedback through the fieldset aria-describedby reference.
Keep focus-visible distinct from selected state and preserve native Space and arrow-key behavior.
Framework adapters should control one group value or use native checkedness, never independent booleans that permit multiple checked colors.

web.notes: Implemented by fieldset, legend, wrapping labels, named native radios, and class composition in components/css/forms.css; no JavaScript is required.

shopify.notes: Shopify product option swatches can render the same class contract.
